# Veeresh Bashetti

> Practical Python, Django, React and SQL guides for beginner developers, written by Veeresh Bashetti, a web developer based in Hubballi, Karnataka, India. Guides include tested code, real examples, linked sources and free learning paths.

## Site

- URL: https://www.veereshbashetti.com
- Author: Veeresh Bashetti
- Topics: Python, Django, React, JavaScript, SQL, APIs, developer tools, career advice for beginner developers

- [Home](https://www.veereshbashetti.com/): Latest developer guides.
